interpretation: Rows are full2M trained policies and complete312-episode evaluation; unfinished jobs are excluded from results, retained in queue reports.
Training curves use50k bins of both sampling slots. They are not deterministic deployment curves.
Error bars on single-policy outcomes are episode SE; no training-seed confidence claim before all3 seeds complete.
Terminal params suffix is optimizer update count, not environment sample steps.
Exploratory/development evidence; no SOTA, zero-risk or endpoint superiority acceptance.
